long_biography.plain_text:
On 11 September 2001, sea captain Sean Kennedy helped evacuate people from Lower Manhattan. He and fellow captain Greg Freitas had set out to carry a news crew towards the World Trade Center. After hearing the Coast Guard's call for assistance, they transported evacuees to Jersey City and later distributed water at Chelsea Piers.

In the days that followed, Kennedy's tour boat carried meals and personnel to Spirit Cruises' floating relief kitchen for rescue workers. The work recalled an earlier emergency: as a child in Biloxi, he had helped after Hurricane Camille struck the Gulf Coast in 1969.

On 11 September 2001, sea captain Sean Kennedy helped evacuate people from Lower Manhattan. He and fellow captain Greg Freitas had set out to carry a news crew towards the World Trade Center. In the days that followed, Kennedy's tour boat carried meals and personnel to Spirit Cruises' floating relief kitchen for rescue workers. The work recalled an earlier emergency: as a child in Biloxi, he had helped after Hurricane Camille struck the Gulf Coast in 1969.
